Info from O'Shea's on 06 6 7180123. A NOTE FROM FR. When I was reading Sunday’s Gospel I was reminded of a time when I was a young priest, a wise old man gave me a piece of advice that has stayed with me ever since. He said, “As a priest, you’ll either do one of two things : you’ll either feed the sheep or ntertain the goats.” I suppose, as priests, we’re faced with a choice : Do I try to please people, or do I try to please God? And if we’re really honest with ourselves, it comes down to this: Do I serve God or my ego? This we ekend, we celebrate the Feast of Christ the King, instituted by Pope Pius XI in 1925 through his encyclical Quas Primas, which means “In the First.” His concern was that the world was turning away from Christ and putting new political ideo logies, such as communism, fascism, extreme natio nalism and secularism, in the place of God. Nazism would later emerge as another example. So the quest ionis: Who is in first place in your life? Who do you serve? As Bob Dylan’s 1979 song Gotta Serve Somebody puts it,“It may be the devil or it may be the Lord.” But, as the song reminds us, we all have to serve somebody. The fears of Pope Pius XIa hundred years ago proved well-founded. We saw the terrible consequences of putting ideologies before God in what became one of the bloodiest centuries in human history. As today’s Gospel reminds us, we cannot separate our love of God from our love of our fellow human beings. I cannot really say that I love humanity without loving God, nor can I say that I love God without loving humanity. When St. Mother Teresa was once asked by an Irish priest whyshe did all shedid for the poorest of the poor? She took his hand said: Glenflesk

Mary Margaret Uí Ghearailt, (Ruiséal), An Daingean agus Bóthar Buí, Ofráil an Fhómhair agus Aifrinntí na Samhna dos na Mairbh Tá na clúdaigh do Ofráil an Fhómhair agus Aifrinntí na Samhna dos na Mairbh curtha amach anois. Buíochas ó chroí dos na daoine a thugann amach na clúdaigh dúinn. Téann an t-airgead ós na bailiúcháin seo go dtí tuarastal an tsagairt. Táimid ana bhuíoch as bhur gcabhair agus bhur bhflaithiúlacht a gus guímid gach beannacht agus rath oraibh agus ar bhur muintir. Gníomh Tíolactha don Chroí Ró-Naofa Táimid cruinnithe le chéile in ainm ár d Tiarna Íosa Críost agus creidimid go bhfuil sé farainn. Déanaimís sinn féin a thíolacadh don Chroí Ró-Naofa i gcomhar le chéile. A Thiarna Íosa Críost, tháinís chun grád'Athar a nochtadh dúinn agus a thoil a dhéan amh. Thugais glóir dó le do bheatha agus leis an mbeatha sin a thabhairt uait ar an gcrois. Ofrálaimidne ár mbeabha in éineacht leat le moladh agus buíochas a bhreith leis le lánchroí. A Chroí Íosa, MacAn Athar, síoraí. Biongó Beidh Biongó ar mhaithe le h Ospidéal Pobail Chorca Dhuibhne, ar siúl Dé Domhnaigh, 22 Samhain ar a 7.00in. Fáilte roimh chách.
